author: coordinator
scope: Rank-correctness/output interpretation only, before experiment approval and any scientific trial; no fixture, sample grid or positive criterion change.
source: Root explicit technical clarification request and Coordinator linear-algebra resolution,2026-10-15; not an observed result or independent scientific review.

allowed: O has log0 and is not an unknown affine-point column.
After exact stable-G/action/lambda certificate, ±alpha^j(P) have logs ±lambda^j modr.
An orbit-representative log may be deduced from these values using the certified nonzero orbit weight.
forbidden: Verifier table assigning logs to arbitrary enumerated G points.
DP/census/planted target scalar truth passed as candidate known-log constraints.
Uncertified scalar action on a nonstable cyclic subgroup.

criterion.variables: One column per distinct actual base/orbit unknown; fixed R shares that column/weight when it is already in the base. Otherwise add exactly one fixed-target unknown, unless R=O. Use a final constant column to encode affine RHS.
criterion.known_matrix_K: For every relevant public-known point T with certified kappa_T, add the affine equation log(T)-kappa_T=0; translate through exact orbit weights. O is zero. If fixed R is a public known orbit point, normalize its RHS even when not in the base.
criterion.new_matrix_N: Verified candidate relation equations for homogeneous R=O or one fixed public-coordinate target R, never with hidden verifier scalar labels. Orbit-transformed family acts on the entire augmented row/target weight.
criterion.formal_diagnostics: Retain formal raw and quotient rank before public normalization, but never label either useful attack yield. Report homogeneous and each fixed-R rank separately, with dimensions and target-column merge certificate.
criterion.consistency: Require affine consistency: no reduced equation0=nonzero. An inconsistent admitted certificate is invalid, not a new useful relation. Known constraints for duplicate public points must agree.
criterion.pooling: Do not pool distinct unknown target columns and count that rank as useful progress for a fixed ECDLP. Any pooled diagnostic must be labeled separately and excluded from the marginal-rank score.
criterion.family_control: A transformed-only source family contributes at most one formal quotient dimension, and possibly zero after known constraints; retain both measurements. Fresh decompositions are evaluated in the same fixed ambient unknown space.

required_output_and_checks: Exact certified public constraint point/value/orbit-weight list,known constraint rank,formal raw/quotient ranks,normalized marginal rank,affine consistency and target-variable merge.
Checker reconstructs allowable public point/value constraints from P,alpha,lambda and negation; a self-reported no-oracle flag alone is insufficient.

Development non-study control where a formal row is already in public-known span must score marginal0; a genuinely independent consistent row may score1. Duplicate known equations and target/base aliasing must not inflate rank.
Preserve zero normalized yield and all formal diagnostics; no assumed advantage or hypothesis promotion.
approval_gate_effect: Before approval, code/checker must implement this criterion and the source/spec/handoff approval snapshot must bind this append-only clarification hash. It is not an approval, protocol amendment after execution, evidence record or claim-changing scientific decision. All existing source/archive receipt bytes stay unchanged.
